title: INT8 weight-only: calibration replay corridor and regression test corridor for GPTQ/AWQ
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create an integration and regression testing corridor that validates INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profiles end-to-end: calibration replay, golden-answer gating, drift detection, and staged rollouts from canary to nightly baseline. This ticket covers orchestration, test artifacts, synthetic stress vectors, and a metrics gating surface to prevent silent accuracy regressions when deploying weight-only quant profiles across heterogeneous fleets.
background: We have multiple existing calibration jobs and nightly regressions, but gaps remain in: replaying customer-like calibration traces deterministically, bridging canary shadow runs into nightly regression baselines, standardizing golden-answer deltas for different model families, and surfacing answer-quality drift when kernel or profile swaps occur. Recent incidents showed silent regressions after an AWQ profile swap on a heterogeneous fleet; root cause tied to per-layer scale variance in long-sequence tails.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic calibration-replay harness that accepts saved calibration traces (prefixes + temperature) and replays to produce per-layer scales and calibration metadata

Automated comparison step that computes golden-answer delta metrics (answer_delta, nist-bleu/ROUGE-like for long-form, and top1 token diff percentage) and flags regressions above configurable thresholds

Regression pipeline that runs on every PR touching quant/profile code and nightly across representative model families (LLama-3x, Falcon-180B, RedGen-13B), producing a human-friendly digest and telemetry export
Canary->nightly bridge: successful canary run must pass gating (quality + latency + resource) for 24h before profile is promoted to nightly baseline
Playbook and rollback automation for detected regressions (auto-fallback to fp16 or previous quant profile) with tracer links to offending PRs and kernel swaps
technical_notes: Calibration replay must preserve seed, tokenization, and KV cache warmup pattern to match production traces
Support both GPTQ and AWQ outputs: normalize profile metadata to a common schema (scales per layer, quant granularity, zero-point flags) for regression diffs
Inject hardware heterogeneity in the harness (A100, H100, 80GB/40GB mix) to detect kernel-selection-induced deviations
Include FP8 baseline runs for a subset of traces to help disambiguate quantization-family regressions versus model drift
Telemetry: emit answer_delta, token_mismatch_rate, perplexity_change_pct, latency_p95_change_ms, and token-cost-per-request to metrics pipeline (datadog/grafana path)
test_plan: Unit: profile-normalizer tests for GPTQ/AWQ -> common schema
Integration: replay harness with 3 curated trace sets (short-conv, long-doc, edge-tokenization) against 3 model families
Canary: 1000 requests/day shadowed against canary nodes for 48h, evaluate quality and latency SLOs
Nightly: run full regression on expanded 10k-example corpus, produce golden-answer delta histogram and failure report
Chaos: toggle kernel selection (fast kernel vs fallback) in staging to verify graceful degradation and no silent accuracy drop
rollout_plan: Stage 0 - local validation: engineers reproduce calibration replay locally and publish profile artifacts to artifact registry
Stage 1 - internal canary: deploy profile to 2% fleet (heterogeneous nodes) in shadow mode for 48h, fail fast on >threshold answer_delta
Stage 2 - extended canary: promote to 10% with live traffic; enable automatic fallback to previous profile if latency_p95 increases >10% or token_mismatch_rate >0.5%
Stage 3 - nightly baseline: if canary passes 24h gating, add profile to nightly baseline and trigger full regression run
Stage 4 - full rollout: promoted after 3 nightly passes with no regressions and exec sign-off from QA/Research
ops_runbook: How to run calibration replay: scripts/calibration/replay.py --trace <s3://bucket/trace> --profile-out /tmp/profile.json --seed 42
How to compare to golden: tools/compare_golden --baseline /goldens/<model>-<date>.json --candidate /tmp/profile.json --metrics answer_delta,token_mismatch_rate
Fallback command (automated): api call to routing service to switch model variant to fp16: POST /v1/admin/routing/fallback {"variant":"fp16", "reason":"regression-detected"}
Dashboards: QuantProfiles / Regression / ENG-203007 (grafana link) shows answer_delta histograms, nightly-pass status, and kernel selection overlays
Alerting: PagerDuty if nightly regression >3% of examples exceed answer_delta threshold OR auto-fallback triggered
Post-mortem checklist: collect calibration trace, kernel logs, telemetry traces, and PR list that changed quant/profile/kernel in last 48h
open_questions: What are per-model answer_delta thresholds? (Research to propose family-specific thresholds based on historical variance)
Do we store full per-token diffs or only aggregate metrics for retention/cost reasons? (cost trade-off with debugging speed)
Should the regression pipeline run FP8 baselines for all models or a sampled subset?
Who owns long-term golden corpus curation? (RESEARCH vs SRE vs QA team)
Allocation: do we reserve dedicated GPUs for nightly regression or time-share with other CI workloads?
